svg.title: Design sheet · Glitter and gems (project 8)
svg.text: Eyes open. Glitter crescents on the cheekbones, a gem arch above each brow, a forehead jewel.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
On a real face: no glitter or gems on the eyelids or lash line. Lessons 06.2 and 06.3.
